airspace.zh: 依民用航空法第99條之13，禁航區、限航區與機場四周一定範圍禁止遙控無人機活動；其餘400呎以下空域依臺北市政府公告的禁止、限制區域管理（現行公告自2024年6月26日生效），且不得飛越人群聚集或集會上空。本園區在市中心，距總統府約1公里、松山機場約5公里，實際飛行前必須先用民航局「Drone Map」App查明是否屬禁限區；禁限區內僅政府機關（構）、學校或法人可於活動15日前申請，未經許可不得飛行。
airspace.en: Under Article 99-13 of the Civil Aviation Act, drones are banned in prohibited and restricted airspace and within set distances of airports; elsewhere below 400 ft, Taipei City's announced no-fly and restricted zones apply (current notice in force since 26 June 2024), and flying over crowds or assemblies is not allowed. The park is in the city centre, about 1 km from the Presidential Office and 5 km from Songshan Airport: check the CAA "Drone Map" app before any real flight; inside prohibited or restricted zones only government bodies, schools or legal persons may apply (normally 15 days ahead), and no flight is allowed without that permission.

cks_hall.note: 藍色八角屋頂、白色牆面的主體建築，位於園區東側、面向西方；高約70公尺（管理處資料）

plaza.zh: 自由廣場（園區中央廣場）
plaza.note: 觀光署開放資料的景點座標（取自本專案 places.json 目錄），落在主堂體西北西約360公尺、正面牌樓內側的廣場

ntch.zh: 國家兩廳院（國家戲劇院一側）
ntch.en: National Theater and Concert Hall (Theater side)
ntch.note: 維基百科「National Theater and Concert Hall」條目座標，落在廣場南側國家戲劇院一帶；國家音樂廳在廣場北側

presidential_office.note: 僅作遠景方位參考：位於主堂體西北西約1.2公里

taipei_101.note: 天際線參考點：位於主堂體東方約4.3公里

songshan_airport.note: 位於主堂體東北方約4.9公里；跑道10/28，長2,605公尺

daan_forest_park.note: 約26公頃的都會公園，位於主堂體東南東約1.5公里

botanical_garden.note: 約8公頃、收集兩千多種植物，位於主堂體西南西約1.3公里

tagline.zh-Hant: 一塊市中心土地，百餘年的用途轉換
tagline.en: A century of changing uses on one block of central Taipei

zh: 臺北市中正區，藍瓦白牆的中正紀念堂。
這塊市中心的土地，用途換過好幾次。
en: Zhongzheng District, Taipei: the blue-roofed, white-walled Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall.
This block of central Taipei has been put to several different uses.

zh: 清代，這裡是臺北城東門外的營地。
管理處的沿革記載，定海正營曾駐紮於此。
en: In the Qing era this was camp ground outside the East Gate of walled Taipei.
The hall's own history records a garrison, the Dinghai battalion, stationed here.

zh: 日治時期此地屬旭町，是步兵與山砲部隊的營區。
en: Under Japanese rule the area, then called Asahi-cho, held infantry and mountain-artillery barracks.

zh: 戰後，陸軍總部等機關設在這裡。
它一度是臺北市區內最大的營區。
en: After 1949 the Army headquarters and related offices occupied the site.
For a time it was the largest military compound inside the city.

zh: 1975年4月蔣中正逝世，行政院核定成立籌建小組。
同年7月，小組選定這片「營邊段」土地。
en: After Chiang Kai-shek died in April 1975, the Executive Yuan approved a planning group.
That July the group chose this parcel, known as the Yingbian section, as the site.

zh: 公開徵求設計，共收到43件建議書。
1976年7月，錄取建築師楊卓成的方案。
en: An open call for designs brought in 43 proposals.
In July 1976 the scheme by the architect Yang Cho-cheng was selected.

zh: 1976年10月31日破土，舊房舍分區拆除。
1977年12月，結構工程正式動工。
en: Ground was broken on 31 October 1976 while the old buildings were cleared in stages.
Structural work formally began in December 1977.

zh: 1979年，牌樓、迴廊與角亭接著開工。
1980年3月31日，建堂工程竣工。
en: In 1979 work started on the gates, corridors and corner pavilions.
Construction of the hall was completed on 31 March 1980.

zh: 1980年4月4日舉行落成典禮。
隔天4月5日，紀念堂正式開放參觀。
en: The inauguration ceremony was held on 4 April 1980.
The next day, 5 April, the hall opened to visitors.

zh: 1987年，廣場兩側的國家戲劇院與音樂廳落成。
紀念園區從此多了表演藝術的功能。
en: In 1987 the National Theater and Concert Hall were completed beside the square.
The memorial park gained a second role as a home for the performing arts.

zh: 1990年3月16日至22日，近六千名大學生在廣場靜坐。
訴求包括解散國民大會、廢除臨時條款。
en: From 16 to 22 March 1990 nearly six thousand university students sat in on this square.
Their demands included dissolving the National Assembly and ending the Temporary Provisions.

zh: 結束前，學生立起自製的「民主野百合」。
這場靜坐後來被稱為野百合學運。
en: Before leaving, the students raised a hand-made "Wild Lily of Democracy".
The sit-in became known as the Wild Lily student movement.

zh: 2007年12月，牌樓題字由「大中至正」改為「自由廣場」。
同年11月，園區被指定為國定古蹟。
en: In December 2007 the inscription on the main gate was changed to "Liberty Square".
A month earlier the site had been designated a national monument.

zh: 2007年紀念堂一度更名為臺灣民主紀念館。
2008年恢復原名，2009年7月匾額重新掛回。
en: In 2007 the hall was renamed National Taiwan Democracy Memorial Hall.
The earlier name was restored in 2008 and its plaque re-hung in July 2009.

zh: 中軸上的瞻仰大道，2007年改稱民主大道。
2024年7月起，儀隊移出銅像大廳，改在大道上操演。
en: The central avenue, once the Boulevard of Homage, became Democracy Boulevard in 2007.
Since July 2024 the honour guard has drilled here instead of inside the statue hall.

zh: 2017年起，文化部推動紀念堂轉型的社會討論。
2022年的公共徵件，共有142組提案參加。
en: Since 2017 the Ministry of Culture has led public discussion on transforming the hall.
An open call for ideas in 2022 drew 142 entries.

zh: 2025年，行政院指示朝民主教育園區轉型。
空間計畫與社會溝通，目前仍在進行。
en: In 2025 the Executive Yuan directed that the site become a park for democracy education.
The spatial plan and public consultation are still under way.

zh: 營區、紀念堂、廣場，同一塊地留下不同年代的痕跡。
它的下一個樣貌，仍在公共討論之中。
en: Barracks, memorial, public square: one block carries the marks of several eras.
What it becomes next is still a matter of public discussion.

tagline.zh-Hant: 兩廳院、公共廣場與公園裡的日常
tagline.en: Two national halls, a public square and everyday life in the park

zh: 自由廣場兩側，是兩座宮殿式屋頂的表演廳。
這趟飛行看的是廣場上的藝文與日常。
en: Two performance halls with palace-style roofs stand on either side of Liberty Square.
This flight looks at the arts and the everyday life that fill the square.

zh: 南側是國家戲劇院，北側是國家音樂廳。
兩廳院在1975年核定興建，1987年完工啟用。
en: The National Theater is on the south side, the National Concert Hall on the north.
Construction was authorised in 1975 and the two halls opened in 1987.

zh: 設計者是楊卓成與和睦建築師事務所。
現代劇場藏在傳統宮殿的外觀裡。
en: They were designed by Yang Cho-cheng with his firm, Architects and Engineers Associates.
Modern stages are housed inside forms borrowed from traditional palaces.

zh: 戲劇院上演戲劇、舞蹈、京劇與兒童節目。
大廳約有一千五百個座位。
en: The Theater stages drama, dance, Peking opera and children's programmes.
Its main auditorium seats about fifteen hundred.

zh: 音樂廳以室內樂與交響樂演出為主，約兩千席。
1987年安裝的管風琴，當時是亞洲最大的一座。
en: The Concert Hall, with about two thousand seats, hosts chamber and symphonic music.
Its pipe organ, installed in 1987, was then the largest in Asia.

zh: 兩廳之間的廣場，本身也是一座露天舞臺。
演出可以在室內與戶外同時進行。
en: The square between the two halls is itself an open-air stage.
Performances can run indoors and outdoors at the same time.

zh: 1992年6月，雲門舞集在廣場演出《薪傳》。
管理處的紀錄寫著，現場有近六萬名觀眾。
en: In June 1992 Cloud Gate Dance Theatre performed "Legacy" on the square.
The hall's records put the audience at nearly sixty thousand.

zh: 2005年，柏林愛樂在音樂廳演出。
數千人聚在廣場上，觀看戶外轉播。
en: In 2005 the Berliner Philharmoniker under Simon Rattle played in the Concert Hall.
Thousands gathered on the square to watch the outdoor broadcast.

zh: 1990年2月，觀光局首次在這裡舉辦大型燈會。
到2000年為止，臺灣燈會都以這裡為會場。
en: In February 1990 the Tourism Bureau held its first large lantern festival here.
The Taiwan Lantern Festival stayed on this site until 2000.

zh: 主堂體的白牆，也曾被當成巨大的投影幕。
1997年，電影《一○一真狗》把它投成黑白斑點。
en: The white walls of the main hall have also served as a giant projection screen.
In 1997 a light show for the film "101 Dalmatians" covered them in black spots.

zh: 堂體下層有六間展廳與一間演藝廳。
2009年曾在這裡舉辦安迪．沃荷展。
en: The lower floors of the hall hold six exhibition galleries and a performance hall.
An Andy Warhol exhibition was held here in 2009.

zh: 廣場也是公眾集會的場所。
2008年的野草莓運動等公民行動，都曾在此聚集。
en: The square is also a place of public assembly.
Civic actions such as the 2008 Wild Strawberry movement have gathered here.

zh: 沿人行道而建的迴廊，每隔4.5公尺有一扇花窗。
其中燈籠窗共有26種造型。
en: The corridor built along the pavements has a window every 4.5 metres.
Its lantern-shaped windows come in 26 different designs.

zh: 清晨與傍晚，附近居民到園區散步運動。
園內人行步道總長約五公里。
en: Early in the morning and towards evening, nearby residents come to walk and exercise.
The park's footpaths add up to about five kilometres.

zh: 園內有忠勇、親民、自強三處健身場。
其中一處就在堂前右側的大榕樹下。
en: Three exercise grounds, Zhongyong, Qinmin and Ziqiang, serve martial arts, dance and morning drills.
One of them lies under a large banyan to the right front of the hall.

zh: 堂內還有一間圖書室，1993年7月開放。
紀念建築裡，陸續加入了閱讀與展覽的功能。
en: Inside there is also a library, opened in July 1993.
Reading and exhibitions were gradually added to a building made for commemoration.

zh: 兩廳院現在隸屬於國家表演藝術中心。
國家交響樂團是音樂廳的常客。
en: The two halls now belong to the National Performing Arts Center.
The National Symphony Orchestra is among the ensembles that play here regularly.

zh: 同一片廣場，容納演出、集會、節慶與每天的運動。
它是臺北市民共用的一塊開放空間。
en: One square holds performances, assemblies, festivals and daily exercise.
It is an open space shared by the people of Taipei.

tagline.zh-Hant: 兩座水池、成排的南洋杉，和住在市區的鳥
tagline.en: Two ponds, rows of araucarias and the birds that live in the city

zh: 臺北市中心的樓房之間，這座園區是一大片樹冠。
除了建築，基地其餘部分都是庭園。
en: Among the buildings of central Taipei, this park shows up as one broad canopy.
Apart from its buildings, the whole site is laid out as gardens.

zh: 東邊一公里半外，是26公頃的大安森林公園。
西邊則有收集兩千多種植物的臺北植物園。
en: A kilometre and a half to the east is the 26-hectare Daan Forest Park.
To the west, the Taipei Botanical Garden keeps more than two thousand plant species.

zh: 園區前段，左右各有一座水池。
雲漢池在戲劇院旁，光華池在音樂廳旁。
en: Towards the front of the park, a pond lies on each side.
Yunhan Pond is beside the Theater, Guanghua Pond beside the Concert Hall.

zh: 兩池都是不規則的人工池，各約三千平方公尺。
池裡有假山、瀑布和半圓形的拱橋。
en: Both are irregular artificial ponds of about three thousand square metres each.
Each has rockwork, waterfalls and a half-round arched bridge.

zh: 雲漢池被拱橋分成上、下兩池。
池邊種著緋寒櫻。
en: An arched bridge divides Yunhan Pond into an upper and a lower pool.
Taiwan cherry trees are planted along its banks.

zh: 池中的錦鯉，最早是1980年開放之初各界捐贈的。
1981年又有110尾錦鯉送到這裡。
en: The koi go back to donations made when the park opened in 1980.
Another 110 koi arrived as a gift in 1981.

zh: 光華池裡有一座長滿水生植物的浮島。
2016到2019年，兩池整修了池體與過濾系統。
en: Guanghua Pond holds a floating island thick with aquatic plants.
Between 2016 and 2019 both ponds were rebuilt and their filtration improved.

zh: 夜鷺和紅冠水雞終年住在池邊。
偶爾也能見到白腹秧雞與小白鷺。
en: Black-crowned night herons and common moorhens live by the ponds all year.
White-breasted waterhens and little egrets are seen from time to time.

zh: 園內還記錄到黑冠麻鷺、綠繡眼和赤腹松鼠。
蝴蝶與蜻蜓也在花木間活動。
en: Malayan night herons, white-eyes and red-bellied squirrels are also recorded in the park.
Butterflies and dragonflies move among the trees and flower beds.

zh: 信義路側的大忠門內，種了八十多株宮粉梅。
粉紅色的重瓣花在二到三月開放。
en: Just inside Dazhong Gate on the Xinyi Road side grow more than eighty pink-flowered mei trees.
Their double blossoms open in February and March.

zh: 通往東北角門的步道旁，有三十多株山櫻花。
1982年，畫家張大千曾贈送12株梅樹。
en: Along the path to the northeast corner gate stand some thirty Taiwan cherry trees.
In 1982 the painter Chang Dai-chien gave the park twelve mei trees.

zh: 堂體後方，有一條與杭州南路平行的南洋杉步道。
樹種以肯氏南洋杉為主，少數是小葉南洋杉。
en: Behind the hall, an araucaria walk runs parallel to Hangzhou South Road.
Most of the trees are hoop pines, with a few Norfolk Island pines.

zh: 1986年3月，各縣市首長在園內栽下蘇鐵與肯氏南洋杉。
步道的泥土被踩得太硬，後來改鋪碎石並換土。
en: In March 1986 mayors and county chiefs planted cycads and hoop pines in the park.
The walk's trampled soil was later loosened with gravel paving and fresh earth.

zh: 步道穿過的虎背生態園區，種的是臺灣低海拔原生植物。
植株依北、中、南的自然分布排列。
en: The walk passes an ecology garden planted with native lowland species of Taiwan.
They are arranged by their natural ranges in the north, centre and south of the island.

zh: 園內的熱帶雨林區，以茂密的榕樹為主體。
區內的生態池用來調節水量。
en: A corner called the rainforest area is built around densely growing banyans.
A small ecological pond there helps regulate water.

zh: 常綠樹之外，還有杜鵑與開黃花的臺灣欒樹。
不同季節，樹冠的顏色跟著改變。
en: Besides evergreens there are azaleas and yellow-flowered Taiwan golden-rain trees.
The colour of the canopy shifts with the seasons.

zh: 中軸大道兩側，是如意圖案的草花花壇。
依管理處資料，園內大小花木超過五十萬株。
en: Flower beds in an auspicious ruyi pattern line both sides of the central boulevard.
By the management's count the park holds more than half a million trees and flowering plants.

zh: 水池、林蔭與花季，讓這裡不只是一座紀念建築。
它也是市中心的鳥類和居民共用的一片綠地。
en: Ponds, shade and flowering seasons make this more than a monument.
It is also a green block shared by the city's birds and its residents.

tagline.zh-Hant: 用尺寸讀一座對稱園區的配置
tagline.en: Reading the layout of a symmetric park through its measurements

zh: 臺北盆地平坦的市區裡，有一塊方正的綠地。
中正紀念堂園區約二十五公頃，沿一條中軸對稱展開。
en: On the flat city floor of the Taipei Basin lies a neat rectangle of green.
The memorial park covers about 25 hectares, laid out symmetrically along one axis.

zh: 往東約四公里，是高508公尺的臺北101。
盆地周圍有山，北邊是陽明山，東南是雪山山脈。
en: About four kilometres east rises Taipei 101, 508 metres tall.
Mountains ring the basin: Yangmingshan to the north, the Xueshan Range to the southeast.

zh: 園區四邊各臨一條道路。
西為中山南路，北為信義路，東為杭州南路，南為愛國東路。
en: Each of the four sides meets a road.
Zhongshan South Road on the west, Xinyi on the north, Hangzhou South on the east, Aiguo East on the south.

zh: 正面牌樓面向中山南路，高30公尺、寬80公尺。
形式是五間六柱十一樓。
en: The main gate faces Zhongshan South Road; it is 30 metres high and 80 metres wide.
Its form has five bays, six pillars and eleven roofs.

zh: 牌樓距主堂體中心線470公尺。
其間的民主大道長380公尺、寬40公尺。
en: The gate stands 470 metres from the centre line of the main hall.
Between them, Democracy Boulevard is 380 metres long and 40 metres wide.

zh: 大道兩旁各有一條寬9公尺的林蔭道。
路面的花崗石由金門軍民捐獻。
en: A tree-lined avenue nine metres wide runs along each side of the boulevard.
Their granite paving was donated by the soldiers and residents of Kinmen.

zh: 中軸上的民主廣場，長寬各120公尺。
地下是可停六百多輛車的停車場。
en: Democracy Square, on the axis, measures 120 metres on each side.
Beneath it is a car park for more than six hundred vehicles.

zh: 兩座表演廳隔著廣場相對，位置互為鏡像。
水池、側門與角亭，也都成對配置。
en: The two performance halls face each other across the square in mirrored positions.
Ponds, side gates and corner pavilions also come in matching pairs.

zh: 主堂體位於基地東側，面向西方。
從地面到寶頂，總高約70公尺。
en: The main hall sits at the east end of the site and faces west.
From the ground to the tip of its finial it stands about 70 metres high.

zh: 三層臺基高14.5公尺，牆身高24公尺。
斗拱到寶頂，再加上31.5公尺。
en: The three-tiered base is 14.5 metres high and the walls rise another 24.
Brackets, roof and finial add the last 31.5 metres.

zh: 從正上方看，藍色琉璃瓦的屋頂呈八角形。
下方的大廳則是40公尺見方。
en: Seen from directly above, the blue glazed-tile roof is an octagon.
The hall beneath it is a square 40 metres on each side.

zh: 正面石階加上大廳內的階梯，共89階。
這個數字對應蔣中正享壽的歲數。
en: The front stairs, together with the steps inside the hall, total 89.
The number matches Chiang Kai-shek's age at his death.

zh: 白色牆面、藍色屋瓦，花壇種的是紅花。
三種顏色呼應國旗的配色。
en: White walls, blue roof tiles, and red flowers in the beds around them.
The three colours echo those of the national flag.

zh: 兩座側門分別開在信義路與愛國東路。
大忠門在北，大孝門在南，各寬19.7公尺。
en: Two side gates open onto Xinyi Road and Aiguo East Road.
Dazhong Gate on the north and Daxiao Gate on the south are each 19.7 metres wide.

zh: 園區外緣的迴廊高5.5公尺。
轉角處的角亭高11.1公尺。
en: The corridor around the edge of the park is 5.5 metres high.
The pavilions at its corners stand 11.1 metres high.

zh: 羅斯福路地下的中正紀念堂站，是兩條捷運線的轉乘站。
en: Under Roosevelt Road, the metro station named after the hall is an interchange of two lines.

zh: 主堂體朝西，視線越過牌樓。
一公里多之外，是總統府所在的街區。
en: The hall looks west, out over its own gate.
A little over a kilometre away lies the district around the Presidential Office.

zh: 東北方約五公里是松山機場，跑道長2605公尺。
機場四周依法劃有禁止無人機活動的範圍。
en: Songshan Airport lies about five kilometres to the northeast, its runway 2,605 metres long.
By law, a zone around the airport is closed to drone activity.

zh: 一條中軸，兩側對稱，四面臨路。

en: One axis, two mirrored sides, four bounding roads.
From the air the park reads like a clearly drawn ground plan.
